Internal whitelist/sale-condition gate for transfers, computes the pair address and checks owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale.

Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits against _onSaleNum and _value.

Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address computation using create2-style hashing.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, transfers and approvals.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
msg.sender is used in transferFrom() for the allowance check and decrement.
msg.sender is written as the owner key of the allowance mapping in approve().
msg.sender is compared against owner before executing the delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender must equal owner to enter batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner to set the trade address.
msg.sender must equal owner to initialize sale parameters.
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom call inside transfer().
_value parameter flows into the transferFrom call inside transfer().
_from parameter is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure().
_to parameter is compared against owner in ensure().
_value parameter is forwarded to condition() from ensure().
_from parameter drives allowance, ensure and balance checks in transferFrom().
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value parameter is deducted from allowance and balances in transferFrom().
_spender parameter is the key written in the allowance mapping.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the raw calldata passed to delegatecall.
saleNum parameter is assigned to the _saleNum state variable.
token parameter is scaled by decimals and assigned to _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by decimals and assigned to _maxSale.
_tos array length drives the batchSend loop bound and total computation.
_value is credited to each recipient and used to compute the total.
addr parameter is stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
User-supplied _value is subtracted/added without SafeMath, enabling integer underflow/overflow of balances.
User-supplied _value multiplied by _tos.length can overflow silently, desynchronizing the balance check.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sellable amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sellable amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether a sale-limit is active.
transferFrom() reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each sale transfer.
batchSend() reads and mutates balanceOf entries without SafeMath protection.
init() writes the computed _minSale state variable.
init() writes the computed _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to whitelist allowed sellers.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to whitelist the configured trade address.
ensure() reads owner to bypass sale conditions for the owner address.
owner gates permission to execute the delegatecall.
owner gates permission to call init().
owner gates permission to call batchSend().
owner gates permission to call setTradeAddress().
owner is compared inside ensure() to bypass the sale-condition requirement.
The unchecked balance update directly writes the balanceOf mapping, allowing balance corruption.
The unchecked multiplication feeds the balanceOf deduction, understating the amount transferred.
pairFor() returns the pair address stored in the local _UNI variable inside ensure().
The local _UNI value is compared against _from inside ensure().
_tos.length is used to compute the local total in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by the recipient count to form the local total.
The computed total controls the balance sufficiency require() in batchSend().
_tos.length bounds the loop counter i in batchSend().
Each iteration assigns _tos[i] to the loop-local recipient _to.
transfer() unconditionally calls transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() and requires it to return true.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected UNI pair address.
delegatecall transfers execution to an arbitrary address, allowing attacker code to run with this contract's storage and potentially re-enter it.
